home.heroTagline: Between raw data and strategic decisions lies a path built of architectures, algorithms and analysis. My job is to design that path and make it scalable, efficient and measurable.

about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Data professional with 5+ years across the full data lifecycle.
about.bio: Data professional with over five years of experience across the full data lifecycle — from data collection and validation to operational dashboards and strategic insights for commercial and C-level teams. I pair a strong statistical foundation (BSc in Statistics, MSc in Data Science in progress) with a practical, result-driven mindset. I work mainly with Python, SQL and cloud tooling on AWS, with experience in process automation and Machine/Deep Learning. Passionate about AI and emerging technologies, I enjoy turning complex data into clear, actionable strategies for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

experience.description: Part of the Business Intelligence team, managing the entire data lifecycle:
highlights: Data collection: extraction and validation of data from digital platforms via APIs, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
Process automation: ETL pipelines on AWS (S3, Athena, Lambda, Glue) to cut manual work and optimise data flows.
Data governance: documentation of analytical processes, business metrics and BI team standards.
SQL & Python analytics: scripts and queries for advanced extractions, anomaly detection, trend analysis and reporting.
Dashboards & reporting: interactive Power BI dashboards for digital performance, traffic, engagement and campaign KPIs.

experience.description: SAS consultant at UniCredit Services, focused on reporting and development on SAS Viya:
highlights: Reporting & data management: development and maintenance of SAS Viya reports with back-end and front-end data management, integrated into operational dashboards.
Compliance & data governance: led a cross-functional project monitoring report access, ensuring GDPR compliance and data quality.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How your personal data is handled when you use this website.

sections.heading: Data Controller
sections.body: The controller of the personal data collected through this website is Marco Manduca. You can reach the controller for any privacy-related matter at marco.manduca95@gmail.com.

sections.heading: What data I collect
sections.body: I only collect the data you voluntarily provide through the contact form: your name, your email address and the content of your message. I do not collect any other personal data and I do not use profiling or tracking technologies.

sections.heading: Why I process it and on what basis
sections.body: Your data is processed solely to read your message and reply to you. The legal basis is your consent, which you give by ticking the box on the contact form (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). Providing the data is optional, but without it I cannot answer you.

sections.heading: Who processes the data
sections.body: Contact messages are transmitted and delivered through Amazon Web Services (Amazon SES), which acts as a data processor. The email is processed within the European Union (Ireland, eu-west-1 region). No data is sold or shared with third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.heading: How long I keep it
sections.body: Your message is stored only as an email for the time needed to handle your request and any follow-up correspondence, after which it is deleted. The website itself does not store contact submissions in any database.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Under the GDPR you have the right to:
items: access your personal data and obtain a copy of it
request restriction of, or object to, the processing
withdraw your consent at any time
lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (Garante per la protezione dei dati personali)

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
sections.body: This website does not use profiling or third-party tracking cookies. It only uses technical local storage that is strictly necessary for the site to work, such as remembering your preferred language.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: This policy may be updated over time. Any changes will be published on this page with a revised "last updated" date.
